title: An Emperor, Rebels and a Star Chef: A Lyon Self-Guided Walking Tour
description: A walk through the Presqu’île, the peninsula between the Rhône and the Saône, from the Saône bridges past Place des Terreaux and the Opéra, with stories of emperors, silk rebels, and chefs.

title: Romans, Plague, and Traboules: A Vieux Lyon Self-Guided Walking Tour
description: A walk through Vieux Lyon, the Renaissance old town below Fourvière, through its traboules and past the cathedral of Saint-Jean, with stories of Romans, plague, and the silk trade.
